digest.component_or_area: LLM routing and model class configuration
propositions: Four hand-built LLM sub-call sites bypass model-class configuration by passing raw cfg without specifying a model class, causing them to inherit cfg.model instead of honoring configured class vocabulary

overlap-judge dominates plan-review traffic at 18 of 23 calls and exclusively routes to direct Anthropic when classes are configured for Bedrock, leaving the majority of plan-review LLM calls on direct Anthropic despite operator intent

ticket-digest runs on the ticket store write path via enrich_drain.maybe_drain called from event_append and push operations, sending ticket content to direct Anthropic during routine store writes with no visibility in gate verdicts

With model classes configured differently from cfg.model, all four bypass sites must select models from the class vocabulary and not inherit cfg.model; the fix must be verifiable via offline test without relying on live run configuration

A general provenance guard must prevent future hand-built sub-calls from silently reintroducing the bypass by analyzing AST patterns of every RunRequest in src/rebar and tracing config expressions back to their source
Fail-safe behavior must be preserved: novelty signal degradation to keep more findings and overlap advisory status that never blocks review
